name: what living on my own has done for my mental health...

music.title: Shimmy In The Back Row - arthur felix

lines.ref:
what living on my own has
done for my mental health...

i learned how to enjoy
my own company

shots.brief: walking into apartment living room (ref: A woman walks into her sunlit, decorated living room and approaches the couch and coffee table.; tripod)
relaxing on the couch at home (ref: High-angle framed view through an archway of the woman sitting on her sofa, checking her phone and having a quiet moment.; tripod)
chilling on sofa with a blanket or drink (ref: View from behind the couch showing the woman pulling up a cozy throw blanket and reaching for a drink on the coffee table.; tripod)

audit.notes: Easily recreated with any peaceful domestic b-roll (sitting on a couch, brewing coffee, reading, looking out the window). The reflective message can be adapted to living alone, moving to a new city, or leaving a stressful job.
audit.summary: A peaceful aesthetic compilation of relaxing alone in a cozy apartment, sharing reflections on how living alone improved mental health.
